description: Detect typosquatting attacks against a package name. Compares using Damerau-Levenshtein distance ≤ 2 against top-10,000 packages. Returns similar_packages with anomaly scores, and a SUSPICIOUS or CLEAN verdict. Uses PyPI and npm download stats stored in Redis. Cold-start fetch on first call (≤ 30s). Rate limit: 60/minute. No auth required. For security engineers auditing supply-chain package names before inclusion. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="security_detect_typosquatting", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, cargo, go. Required.
